body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 4 units. Until your next turn, reduce forced movement against it by 2 units.

surges.html: One ally inside, warded by, or otherwise protected by this Rite gains +1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1.

rider.title: WARD RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: An enemy enters a space adjacent to the warded creature. Echo: The warded creature gains +1 Defense and may move 1 unit after the enemy's Action resolves.
